title: Radar makes podcasts searchable
teaser: Particle, a startup founded by former Twitter engineers, launched Radar—a podcast search engine that transcribes audio and understands the content of conversations. The service already indexes more than 130 000 podcasts, including all 200 of Apple’s most popular shows across 135 categories, and adds 20 000 episodes daily. Radar extracts quotes, tags people, companies and topics, tracks their mentions and provides data through a web interface, API and MCP. Its main clients are hedge funds that need information unavailable to ordinary AI agents, which are focused mainly on text.
